scope: NARROW validation by the lead's scope decision: one shared C predicate (check_candidate_reply, NEED_PLACEMENT) and its existing C control. Run: formatting, the real shared C offer/dialogue control, the source guard, a weapon-fixture build and strict clippy of eech-engine-sys. NOT the 16-step feature matrix: the parent fb3163f28 matrix (16 steps all 0, 1183 tests, 65 result rows) is PARENT evidence only and is not new-head results. Rust, the kernel, the model provider, features and the closed narrow phase and TREE are unchanged in this commit (changed paths below).

red_against_parent.meaning: the three coherent placement positives passed; every malformed role was wrongly accepted (six exchange-level refusals and five offer-level cases failed). The offer-level unflagged case passes on the parent only by accident (a later zero state), so the exchange-level unflagged case is its genuine control.

mutation_controls.meaning: three mutants of the predicate (no scene requirement, a direct building accepted by role, a building under a city required to have its fixed facts) each failed the control (dialogue=101 in each log) and the header was restored byte for byte. The first run of a different mutant (city accepted) SURVIVED because a city always has scene 0, which the scene rule already refuses; the control gained a direct city building given a scene, which discriminates the role, and that mutant was replaced (the first summary is retained as mutants-summary-first-city-accepted-survived.txt).

new_test_coverage: exchange level: positives for a mobile candidate, a building under a city (fixed facts not given) and an ordinary fixed candidate; refusals for a city, a direct city building (scene 0 and with a scene), an entity neither mobile nor fixed, an ordinary fixed candidate, a mobile candidate and a building under a city each without a scene. Offer level (the real offer over scripted entities, exact getter log): city MFCBPX, direct building MFCG, unflagged MF, scene-less fixed MFCGSP, scene-less mobile MSPV, scene-less building under a city SP: each stopped at entity_candidate.state with no heading, align flag or attitude read and no narrow phase.

code_inputs.meaning: filtered = Git blob id as the clean filter would store each working file; raw = SHA-256 of the raw working bytes; three pre-existing CRLF files keep the documented qualification; no accepted file was normalised
